stations.title: Idris
stations.say: One list of every item, please.
stations.note: He copies three by hand each night.

stations.title: Your reader
stations.text: Reads each supplier list, one at a time.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Idris wants one list of every supplier's items each night.
The reader reads each list, but nothing writes them back, so he copies them by hand.
You write values back as JSON text and run the whole import, in three tasks.
Now every list that reads goes into one file, and the broken one is named by line.
Same three suppliers, and a price list the shop reads and writes on its own.
